arxiv-1808-00588.title: Weather Classification: A new multi-class dataset, data augmentation approach and comprehensive evaluations of Convolutional Neural Networks Thanks: This work is supported by the UK Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council through grants EP/R02572X/1 and EP/P017487/1
arxiv-1808-00588.creator: Jose Carlos Villarreal Guerra 1 , Zeba Khanam 1 , Shoaib Ehsan 1 , Rustam Stolkin 2 , Klaus McDonald-Maier 1
arxiv-1808-00588.description: Abstract Weather conditions often disrupt the proper functioning of transportation systems. Present systems either deploy an array of sensors or use an in-vehicle camera to predict weather conditions. These solutions have resulted in incremental cost and limited scope. To ensure smooth operation of all transportation services in all-weather conditions, a reliable detection system is necessary to classify weather in wild.

arxiv-2107-11585.title: TWO HEADED DRAGONS: MULTIMODAL FUSION AND CROSS MODAL TRANSACTIONS
arxiv-2107-11585.creator: Rupak Bose, Shivam Pande, Biplab Banerjee
arxiv-2107-11585.description: Abstract As the field of remote sensing is evolving, we witness the accumulation of information from several modalities, such as multispectral (MS), hyperspectral (HSI), LiDAR etc. Each of these modalities possess its own distinct characteristics and when combined synergistically, perform very well in the recognition and classification tasks.

arxiv-2111-11867.title: Quantum Analogue of Entropy Based DDoS Detection
arxiv-2111-11867.creator: Del Rajan ID
arxiv-2111-11867.description: Abstract Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attacks can occur in quantum networks, which can pose a significant threat to its key distribution protocols. We introduce a quantum analogue of a classical entropic DDoS detection system, and apply it in the context of detecting an attack on a quantum network.

arxiv-2203-11216.title: The Conceptual VAE
arxiv-2203-11216.creator: Razin A. Shaikh, Sara Sabrina Zemljič, Sean Tull, Stephen Clark
arxiv-2203-11216.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Razin A. Shaikh, Sara Sabrina Zemljič, Sean Tull, Stephen Clark. In this report we present a new model of concepts, based on the framework of variational autoencoders, which is designed to have attractive properties such as factored conceptual domains, and at the same time be learnable from data.

arxiv-2211-02257.title: Certification with an NP oracle
arxiv-2211-02257.creator: Guy Blanc, Caleb Koch, Jane Lange, Carmen Strassle, Li-Yang Tan
arxiv-2211-02257.description: Abstract In the certification problem , the algorithm is given a function f f with certificate complexity k k and an input x ⋆ x^{\star} , and the goal is to find a certificate of size ≤ poly ⁡ ( k ) \leq\mathrm{poly}(k) for f f ’s value at x ⋆ x^{\star} .

arxiv-2402-12117.title: Still mystery after all these years — Unconventional superconductivity of Sr 2 RuO 4 —
arxiv-2402-12117.creator: Yoshiteru Maeno 1, Shingo Yonezawa 2,3, Aline Ramires 4
arxiv-2402-12117.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yoshiteru Maeno 1, Shingo Yonezawa 2,3, Aline Ramires 4. (Dated: August 7, 2026) This review describes recent significant research developments made on the layered perovskite Sr 2 RuO 4 and discusses current issues from both experimental and theoretical perspectives. Since the discovery of superconductivity in Sr 2 RuO 4 in 1994, studies using high-quality single crystals quickly revealed it to be an archetypal unconventional superconductor among strongly correlated electron systems.

arxiv-2403-12457.title: Privacy-Preserving Face Recognition Using Trainable Feature Subtraction
arxiv-2403-12457.creator: Yuxi Mi, Zhizhou Zhong, Yuge Huang, Jiazhen Ji, Jianqing Xu, Jun Wang, Shaoming Wang, Shouhong Ding, Shuigeng Zhou
arxiv-2403-12457.description: Abstract The widespread adoption of face recognition has led to increasing privacy concerns, as unauthorized access to face images can expose sensitive personal information. This paper explores face image protection against viewing and recovery attacks. Inspired by image compression, we propose creating a visually uninformative face image through feature subtraction between an original face and its model-produced regeneration.

arxiv-2404-05223.title: ITA-ECBS: A Bounded-Suboptimal Algorithm for the Combined Target-Assignment and Path-Finding Problem
arxiv-2404-05223.creator: Yimin Tang, Sven Koenig, Jiaoyang Li
arxiv-2404-05223.description: Abstract Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF), i.e., finding collision-free paths for multiple robots, plays a critical role in many applications. Sometimes, assigning a target to each agent also presents a challenge. The Combined Target-Assignment and Path-Finding (TAPF) problem, a variant of MAPF, requires one to simultaneously assign targets to agents and plan collision-free paths for agents.

arxiv-2502-12000.title: The Complexity of Dynamic LZ77 is Θ ~ ​ ( n 2 / 3 ) \tilde{\Theta}(n^{2/3})
arxiv-2502-12000.creator: Itai Boneh, Shay Golan, Matan Kraus
arxiv-2502-12000.description: Abstract The Lempel-Ziv 77 (LZ77) factorization is a fundamental compression scheme widely used in text processing and data compression. In this work, we investigate the time complexity of maintaining the LZ77 factorization of a dynamic string. By establishing matching upper and lower bounds, we fully characterize the complexity of this problem.

arxiv-2509-17417.title: Stabilizer Rényi Entropy and its Transition in the Coupled Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev Model
arxiv-2509-17417.creator: Pengfei Zhang, Shuyan Zhou, Ning Sun
arxiv-2509-17417.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Pengfei Zhang, Shuyan Zhou, Ning Sun. Quantum entanglement and quantum magic are two distinct fundamental resources that enable quantum systems to exhibit complex phenomena beyond the capabilities of classical computer simulations. While quantum entanglement has been extensively used to characterize both equilibrium and dynamical phases, the study of quantum magic, typically quantified by the stabilizer Rényi entropy (SRE), remains largely limited to numerical simulations of moderate system sizes.

arxiv-2510-23614.title: How to see the forest for the trees
arxiv-2510-23614.creator: Erika Bérczi-Kovács, András Frank
arxiv-2510-23614.description: Abstract One of the major starting points of discrete optimization is the theorem of Nash-Williams and Tutte on the existence of k k disjoint spanning trees of a graph along with its counterpart on the existence of k k forests covering all edges of the graph.

pmc-10523273.creator: Lijun Xu, Minghan Zhou, Xiuming Peng, Yufan Xu, Fan Huang, Linyun Wang, Xiaorong Peng, Zongxing Yang, Ran Tao, Guanjing Lang, Qing Cao, Minwei Li, Ying Huang, Biao Zhu, Yan Xu

pmc-11385704.title: Effect of rotavirus vaccination on the burden of rotavirus disease and associated antibiotic use in India: A dynamic agent-based simulation analysis
pmc-11385704.creator: Alec Gleason, Chirag K Kumar, Eili Klein, Ramanan Laxminarayan, Arindam Nandi
pmc-11385704.description: Background: Rotavirus is a leading cause of diarrhea in infants and young children in many low- and middle-income countries. India launched a childhood immunization program for rotavirus in 2016, starting with four states and expanding it to cover all states by 2019.

pmc-11431229.title: Modified Prophylactic Donor Lymphocyte Infusion (DLI) in an Adult T Cell Lymphoma/Leukemia (ATLL) Patient—Modality of Relapse Prevention
pmc-11431229.creator: Alexandra Ionete, Alexandru Bardas, Zsofia Varady, Madalina Vasilica, Orsolya Szegedi, Daniel Coriu, Maurizio Battino, Eleftheria Hatzimichael
pmc-11431229.description: Adult T-cell Leukemia/Lymphoma (ATLL) is a rare but aggressive malignancy associated with the human T-cell lymphotropic virus type 1 (HTLV-1). ATLL is a challenging malignancy characterized by its aggressive nature and poor prognosis. Despite advancements in treatment, relapse rates remain high. Donor lymphocyte infusion (DLI) is a promising therapeutic option post-hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT) to prevent relapse.

pmc-11624113.title: Sustained Leadership Practices and Behaviours Following Postgraduate Leadership Education: A Qualitative Study
pmc-11624113.creator: Rebekkah Middleton, Suzanne Murray, Sally Peters, Amy Montgomery, Elizabeth Halcomb
pmc-11624113.description: AimTo explore how postgraduate leadership education is translated into practice and how leadership practices and behaviours are sustained following completion of a leadership program.DesignA qualitative exploratory study using an appreciative inquiry approach.MethodsA single Health District, partnered with a regional university, offering a 12‐month leadership program, the Effective Leadership in Health Program.

pmc-11714441.title: MCI Diagnosis and Neighborhood Disadvantage Predict Differences in White Matter Microstructure in a Rural Aging Cohort
pmc-11714441.creator: Andrew R Bender, Pavithran Pattiam Giriprakash, Dietmar Cordes, Xiaowei Zhuang, Jessica ZK Caldwell, Justin B Miller
pmc-11714441.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundDiffusion magnetic resonance imaging (dMRI) studies show cerebral white matter alterations are associated with both mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and contextual psychosocial factors. However, these reports are almost exclusively based on older adults residing in metropolitan areas. Individuals living in rural communities face increased risk for Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias, but little is known regarding the sensitivity of dMRI markers to incident MCI or psychosocial stressors in this population.

pmc-12421757.title: Implementation of a midwifery preceptor program in Sierra Leone: a qualitative evaluation using the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research
pmc-12421757.creator: Nicholas M. Raposo, Olivia Yang, Alice Konyani, Chrisencia Owoko, Adelaide Debrah, Jennina Rose Viera, Mustapha Sonnie, Julie Mann, Brittney J. van de Water
pmc-12421757.description: BackgroundSierra Leone has the world’s third highest incidence of maternal mortality, with 443 deaths per 100,000 live births. Strengthening the country’s midwifery workforce is essential to providing adequate maternal healthcare and reducing preventable perinatal mortality. In support of this goal, we developed and implemented a midwifery preceptor program (MPP) to train experienced midwives to effectively mentor new and student midwives.

pmc-13171079.title: Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing with a Defibrillator Lead in a Patient with Recurrent Ventricular Tachycardia and Severe Nonischemic Cardiomyopathy: A Case Report
pmc-13171079.creator: Arindam Pande, Dilip Kumar, Rabin Chakraborty
pmc-13171079.description: Left bundle branch area (LBBA) pacing is an innovative approach for permanent cardiac pacing. Combining LBBA pacing with an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) system can reduce the number of leads required in patients who need both therapies, thereby lowering hardware burden, reducing costs, and potentially improving safety.

pmc-13406243.title: Association between serum potassium levels and hearing loss: Evidence from a cross-sectional study based on NHANES
pmc-13406243.creator: Xiao-Zou Luo, Jian Luo, Jie Shen, Deng-Chao Wang
pmc-13406243.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Hearing loss is a global public health issue, and potassium imbalance may affect inner ear function, thereby impacting hearing. Currently, research on the association between serum potassium levels and hearing loss remains limited. This study utilized National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey data to investigate the relationship between serum potassium levels and hearing loss, offering a theoretical basis for the prevention of hearing loss.
